test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Padma Shri awardee Guru Gangadhar Pradhan is an accomplished dancer of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri awardee Guru Gangadhar Pradhan**

 
 
• **Guru Gangadhar Pradhan was an eminent Odissi exponent, choreographer, and teacher.**
 
• He founded both the prestigious **Orissa Dance Academy as well as Konark Natya Mandap. **
 
• He was a** member of the Central Sangeet Natak Akademi.**
 
• He served as the **President of the Odissa Sangeet Natak Akademi. **
 
• Guruji was awarded the** Sanjukta Panigrahi Memorial National Award (2002).**
 
• He was awarded the** Sanskruti Bharatee Award from the National Council of Asian Indian Associations (2002).**
 
• Guruji was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1998.**
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri in 2008** which is India's fourth highest civilian award.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• List of Padma Shri awardees in 2022
 
 
• **Durga Bai Vyam** was honored for her** outstanding work in art.**
 
• **Kaajee Singh ‘Vidyaarthee’** was accorded in the art field for his work towards the **promotion of cultural music.**
 
• **Konsam Ibomcha Singh was** honored for his distinguished work in **preserving the century-old art of doll making.**
 
• Filmmaker **Chandraprakash Dwivedi** was awarded for his **work in television.**
 
• **Khalil Dhantejvi** was honored for** championing the ascent of the Gujarati language** in Ghazal literature. 
 
• **Dr. Shyamamani Devi** was honored for contributing to the systematic **development of Odishi music.**
 
• **Pandit S Ballesh Bhajanti **was awarded for carrying forward the **legacy of Benares Gharana style.**
